proposals.title: Shareholder Right to Call a Special Shareholder Meeting
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend governing documents so holders of 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Company recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Request for Board of Directors to Adopt Policy for an Independent Chair
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt a policy and amend bylaws requiring the Board Chair to be an independent member of the Board.
proposals.evidence: The Company recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: POLITICAL SPENDING MISALIGNMENT
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the company to publish an annual report analyzing whether political and electioneering expenditures align with publicly stated company values and policies.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Achieving Gender and Racial Equity on the Board of Directors
proposals.proponent: NorthStar Asset Management, Inc. Funded Pension Plan
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to report within six months on action steps to foster greater racial and gender equity on the board.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: REPORT ON DEFORESTATION
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the company to issue a report assessing how it could increase the scale, pace, and rigor of efforts to eliminate deforestation and primary forest degradation in its supply chains.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: RACIAL EQUITY AUDIT
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Master Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Urges the board to oversee an independent racial equity audit analyzing the company's adverse impacts on nonwhite stakeholders and communities of color, with public disclosure.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.
